## My favorite equation

::: columns

::: {.column width="45%"}

Lovely *Poisson* distribution:

$$
\frac{\lambda^k e^{-\lambda}}{k!} \text{, where } \lambda \in (0, \infty) \text{ and } k \in \mathbb{N_0}
$$

**Fun fact**: rhymes with croissant (sort of)
